description: Ordinary non-confidential public-cloud NVIDIA H100 capacity, including spot and preemptible instances, used as one replica of an N-way independent replication. NVIDIA confidential-computing mode is not enabled and no NVIDIA attestation report is collected, so a single run on this target is an unattested local record. It is not interchangeable with azure_ncc40ads_h100_v5 and must never be presented as its cheaper equivalent.
